title: We just crossed 1000 users with trademates.co and almost 500€ MRR
author: tradematesHQ
selftext:
We crossed 1,000 users yesterday and have roughly €500 MRR. That's tiny in startup terms, but it matters to us because it means real people are paying for something that actually helps them and creates real value for the users.

Why Trademates works for our users based on their feedback:

Most AI investing tools either dump raw data on you or pretend to be a magic money machine. We do neither.

We built a model that scores any stock and gives you an investment score which is based on the probability that your investment will gain value in the next 90 days. The system explains why it scores that way, and gives you a clear action plan. No black box. No "trust the algorithm." You see the fair value, the fundamentals, the technicals, and the risks.

What actually creates value

\- Speed: Research that used to take hours now takes seconds.

\- Clarity: A single score + verdict instead of tabs, charts, dashboards etc.

\- Honesty: We show when the model is uncertain or bearish. We backtest our own scores and publish the results, including the bad months.

\- No hype: Everything is framed as model output, not investment advice.

The 1,000 users aren't using trademates because we promised get-rich-quick. But because we help them make better and more conservative and data based decisions. That's why trademates is not made for day traders, option traders and other casino style trading activities.

If you're using AI for investing, the question isn't "which tool has the best-looking charts." It's "which tool makes me understand what I own and why."

That's the bet we're building on.
